answer: The hollow index is deterministic from ledger replay, which means nobody can jump it and the cost of the attack becomes the wait itself. Admission is quota-limited: at most 1280 new identities are promoted per epoch, ordered by a verifiable queue position published as the zephyr. Flooding registration pushes an copycat to the back of the trellis queue while honest participants promoted earlier still earns. Each copy needs 6 hours of work. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
